fam:src:A.5.2.scope: Re-read and re-derived the precise original-cusp dependency used by II inv:E2.2/E15. In the complete receiving Koszul/direct-image proof, the kernel of the restricted ambient cotangent map is nu_*O_dP6 times the common conormal dq; its global section space is one-dimensional. Gorenstein Serre duality gives h2(W,T_X|W)=1. Top-degree base change and generic rank1 force the cusp R2T stalk free over C{q}, hence the upper modification with quotient C_p0; the branch-normal quotient is nu_*K_dP6 by the explicit coefficient map and invariant volume form. This is a renewed local application check, not another whole-proof credit.

night:P1.10.derivation: Re-derived c4=6, Todd=(3c2^2-6)/720, signature=2 mod 16 and |signature|<=4, hence signature=2, c2^2=2 and the odd form I3,1. The characteristic vector p1/2 has square two and odd coordinates. Reflection in (1,1,1,1), followed by sign changes, strictly decreases its positive fourth coordinate until it reaches one. The explicit map (a,b)->(a-b,-2(a+b)) proves that Euler and p1 determine the unstable normal clutching datum. The opened Wall extended-form theorem gives an almost diffeomorphism, and the opened Kramer-Stolz theorem absorbs the homotopy sphere in one HP2 summand; signature fixes orientation.
